messages.subject: R1048 report complete: GDN head and precision boundary
messages.body: I wrote the bounded source-only R1048 report and verified it is 9,198 bytes, below the 9,500-byte cap. SGLang's TP1 grouped V→K mapping differs from Strata's modulo mapping, but a concrete bijective permutation can reconcile them and supplied converter provenance does not prove a checkpoint bug; the report also defines the BF16/FP32 chunk64 boundary and validation recipe. Main still needs to resolve actual GGUF conversion provenance and run its separately owned benchmark/softmax work; no runtime or quality claim is made.
